entities.summary: Benjamin Franklin Chavis Jr. is an African-American activist, author, journalist, and the current president and CEO of the National Newspaper Publishers Association. He serves as national co-chair for the political organization No Labels. In 1997 he converted to Islam and took the name Benjamin Chavis Muhammad.
